title: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Delayed Feedback: Coverage Guarantees and a Delay-to-Memory Diagnostic
summary: Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) extends conformal prediction to non-exchangeable settings by adjusting the nominal miscoverage level online in response to recent coverage errors. When forecasts are issued with horizon $τ$, however, the outcome needed to evaluate a prediction is observed only $τ$ steps later, so these adaptive updates must rely on delayed feedback. We study this setting and ask how the effect of delay depends on the persistence of the residual process.
